summary: Phase 2 AI Marketing Studio end-to-end verification on Lakeview Burgers & Seafood admin dashboard. Webpack build is unblocked. Backend: 25/25 AI-Ads tests pass (templates, stats, config GET/PUT, providers, settings GET/PUT, campaigns list, assets CRUD with all filters q/kind/platform/status/is_favorite, NEW duplicate endpoint, auth-unauth protection). LIVE LLM KEY CONFIRMED — all 6 generation endpoints (generate, generate/social, generate/email, generate/sms, generate/image_concept, generate/video_concept) returned 200 with valid output. Frontend: login works with password Lakeview872, admin_token (43 chars) stored in localStorage, session persists across page reload, all 10 dashboard tabs render (Analytics, Specials, Site Content, Menu Editor, Giveaway, Loyalty, Messages, Inquiries, Subscribers, AI Ads), zero console errors. AI Ads tab shows 5 stat cards + all 8 sub-tabs (Campaign Builder, Social, Email, SMS, Image Studio, Video Studio, Library, Settings). Settings panel model select carries provider|model values (openai|gpt-5, openai|gpt-5-mini, anthropic|claude-sonnet-4-5-...) and saves correctly. Creative Library Duplicate button renders with data-testid `ai-asset-{id}-duplicate`. Menu Editor still functional (Appetizers/Soups/Salads/Burgers/Sandwiches/Tacos/Fried Plates/Family Dinners/Sides categories render with item counts).

issues: Favorite (Star), Archive, and Delete buttons in CreativeLibrary.jsx LibraryRow lack data-testid attributes (only the new Duplicate button has one at line 66). critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/ai-ads/assets/{id}/duplicate (ai_ads.py:425-441) correctly resets id/status/favorite/timestamps and adds '(Copy)' suffix. Returns clone without _id. Verified end-to-end: original favorite/status preserved on original, clone has fresh draft/false.
All AI-Ads endpoints properly call await verify_session(authorization, session_token) and reject unauthenticated requests with 401 (verified via fresh-cookieless request). Bearer-token auth works.
Provider catalog endpoint returns {available: [...], enabled: bool} per kind — different from a plain array. Document the response shape if exposed to external consumers.
Refactor remains clean — ai_ads.py is 485 lines, well under 700-line threshold. Phase 2 added Specialty generators, Creative Library CRUD, Providers, Settings without monolith bloat.
Frontend AiAdsTab + sub-tabs render with zero console errors. shared.jsx refactor (plain divs vs shadcn Card) did not break visual layout — stat cards and panels render correctly.
